    • moveItem

      public void moveItem(Case itemCase, String destUri) throws com.netgrif.application.engine.objects.petrinet.domain.throwable.TransitionNotExecutableException
      Changes location of menu item. If non-existing location is provided, the new location is created and then the item is moved. Cyclic destination path is forbidden (f.e. from "/my_node" to "/my_node/my_node2"
      Specified by:
      moveItem in interface IMenuItemService
      Parameters:
      itemCase - Instance of menu_item to be moved
      destUri - destination path where the item will be moved. F.e. "/my_new_node"
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the path is forbidden
      com.netgrif.application.engine.objects.petrinet.domain.throwable.TransitionNotExecutableException

    • duplicateItem

      public Case duplicateItem(Case originItem, I18nString newTitle, String newIdentifier) throws com.netgrif.application.engine.objects.petrinet.domain.throwable.TransitionNotExecutableException
      Duplicates menu item. It creates new menu_item instance with the same dataSet as the provided item instance. The only difference is in title, menu_item_identifier and associations. Configuration cases are duplicated as well.
      Specified by:
      duplicateItem in interface IMenuItemService
      Parameters:
      originItem - Menu item instance, which is duplicated
      newTitle - Title of menu item, that is displayed in menu and tab. Cannot be empty or null.
      newIdentifier - unique menu item identifier
      Returns:
      duplicated Case instance of menu_item
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the input data are invalid or the menu item of the new identifier already exists
      com.netgrif.application.engine.objects.petrinet.domain.throwable.TransitionNotExecutableException
